resolution.note: ship's PrView schema reads a null statusCheckRollup as [] (no checks yet); regression test red before, green after.

title: Ship waits through a pr view whose check rollup is null
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-16 shipping #1186 (t-gt33vxe): `krn pr ship` exited 70 with a zod error "statusCheckRollup: Invalid input: expected array, received null" right after it enabled auto-merge; the PR then merged unattended (79b3af4) while ship had already given up, and a rerun refused with 66 (empty diff).
Outcome: ship reads a gh pr view whose statusCheckRollup is null as no checks yet and keeps waiting to its verdict.
Proof: a ship test whose fake gh answers pr view with statusCheckRollup null, then merged, ends in `verdict: merged`.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
